title: Durable action intent and outcome reconciliation with no real input

working_tree_tests.runner: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -q

clean_extraction_tests.runner: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -q

safety_invariants: Uncertain dispatch is durable before any future physical input, and is never auto-retried
Only one uncertain dispatch may exist globally across all accounts
Action ID and logical action key prohibit duplicate dispatch
Exact intent/evidence account, fight, turn, actor, client generation and revision scope required
Unknown and inconclusive outcomes do not imply success
SQLite action-event-evidence updates are atomic, with injected rollback faults tested
Read-only audits verify event hash chain, projection parity and evidence records
Every report is synthetic, non-actionable and cannot produce physical input
limitations: All actions and outcomes are synthetic fixtures, not actual game events
No physical driver, current-build protocol proof, real causal outcome correlator or Windows acceptance
Power-loss durability on Windows is not tested
Historic test suite produces SQLite ResourceWarnings; cause not yet isolated
Occasional slow verification runs remain possible, now with explicit timeout diagnostics
note: The percent is a weighted planning estimate, not an engineering quality score.
